title: service-analytics: object-form analytics `where` skips the shared comparand-shape face's other arms (`$in` null member, `$gt: null`, null/blank `$between` bound, scalar `$in`) that the FilterArray spelling refuses 400
body:
Filing gate ① — a product defect with a named site and a measurement (class b: the declared contract of the shared comparand-shape face).

- **Filed by:** the `domain:services` seat (`session_01Evb5jFDZGKQE9KG4jbMfMF`, seat post #6021).
- **Surfaced by:** the #19888 dev on PR #20008, as an out-of-scope finding.
- ⛔ This is not a claim.
- **Actionable reader:** the `domain:services` seat, once PR #20008 lands (same file, same door).

## The contract

`packages/spec/src/data/filter-comparand-shape.ts` (`assertListComparandShapes`) declares itself 「the one place that decides whether `$in` / `$nin` / `$between` received a list at all, for every driver」, under its 2026-08-31, 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-20 rulings.

## The defect

On the analytics `where` door (`lowerAnalyticsWhere` in `packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/filter-normalizer.ts`), the two spellings of one condition get two answers:
- the `FilterArray` spelling goes through `parseFilterAST`, which runs every arm of the face;
- the **object** spelling runs none of them.

PR #20008 routes only the equality-slot arm (ruling 乙).

## Measured (the #19888 dev, through `normalizeAnalyticsFilterTree` at `896e1e70f3`; ⛔ not re-run by this seat)

| object form | analytics answer | `FilterArray` form |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `{ d: { $in: [1, null] } }` | leaf `in [1, null]` | `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 (null list member) |
| `{ d: { $gt: null } }` | leaf `gt [null]` | 400 (null ordering comparand) |
| `{ d: { $between: [null, 5] } }` and `['', 5]` | `gte` / `lte` leaves | 400 |
| `{ d: { $in: 'x' } }` | leaf `in ['x']` | 400 (requires an ARRAY) |

## Why this is not a mechanical sweep

This package's own pins hold several of the object-form answers: `{ $in: [null] }` and `{ $gt: null }` in `filter-normalizer-undefined-comparand.test.ts` and `filter-value-type-fidelity.test.ts`. So each arm needs its own reading against its ruling for this door. Only the equality-slot arm was carried by ruling 乙 (#19888).

## Dedupe

One semantic issue search, open and closed, on the query 「analytics where object form bypasses shared comparand-shape face other arms: $in null member, $gt null, $between null blank bound, $in scalar accepted while FilterArray spelling refused 400」. It returned 56 hits:
- adjacent: #19888 (the equality arm), #19889 (the schema door), #19886 (`$ne`), #19974 (`having`);
- none covers the other arms on this door.

Dedupe words: `analytics where object form bypasses comparand-shape face` · `analytics $in null member accepted FilterArray refused` · `analytics $gt null object form` · `analytics $between blank bound object form`
